navigation_model.model: Persistent workspace sidebar with task-oriented groups; contextual breadcrumbs and command-style actions inside work areas
rules: Keep primary task action in page header
Use drawers for candidate preview/edit to preserve list context

patterns: Persistent status banner for active jobs
Bulk selection toolbar appears only after selection
Confirm archive/ignore; allow retry for failed jobs
Use optimistic UI only for reversible local selection; server mutations show pending state
interaction_architecture.permission_model: workspace_owner in MVP; all data reads/mutations require authenticated workspace context
tradeoffs: A persistent job surface adds navigation overhead but prevents silent long-running work
Drawer editing preserves list context but requires explicit save/cancel focus management

related_stage_3_constraints: UX must account for async API/job status states
Bulk actions need clear partial-failure handling

ux_decisions.decision: Workspace owner is the only MVP interactive role; AI admin permissions are represented as a workspace settings capability.
Long-running imports use a persistent job status surface and can be left and resumed.
ux_decisions.reason: Stage 3 requires BullMQ jobs and user-visible status.

ux_decisions.decision: Utilitarian visual direction with Bento modular grouping is the recommended design direction.
ux_decisions.reason: The product is a high-frequency operations/catalog tool with dense tables and async status.

ux_decisions.decision: Destructive archive/ignore actions require confirmation; bulk actions report partial success per item.
ux_decisions.reason: Discovery review is a trust boundary before catalog writes.

risks.risk: Users cannot understand long-running import progress
risks.mitigation: Persistent job detail, step timeline, event log, retry/cancel, and partial-result access

risks.risk: AI extraction creates unsafe or duplicate catalog records
risks.mitigation: Discovery Session review gate, deterministic validation, explicit conflict states, no direct AI catalog writes

risks.risk: Dense tables reduce mobile and assistive-technology usability
risks.mitigation: Responsive stacked records, semantic table headers, keyboard selection, live announcements
